summary: Re-establish routine from scratch — short Z2 cycling sessions, build the habit, introduce aerobic stimulus

sessions.name: Aerobic Spin with Cadence Focus
sessions.focus: Z2 aerobic base, cadence efficiency at 90+ rpm

steps.description: Easy Z1 spin, build cadence to 90 rpm, HR under 145
Z2 aerobic, 90-95 rpm, HR 146-162 bpm — upper half of Z2, fully conversational
Easy spin, HR return below 140

sessions.name: Active Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Active recovery, flush legs, no aerobic loading

steps.description: Genuinely easy, 80-85 rpm, HR well under 145
Z1 blood flow, 80-85 rpm, HR under 145 bpm throughout — reduce power 10W if sleep was poor
Wind down naturally

sessions.name: Aerobic Pyramid Ride
sessions.focus: Progressive Z2 aerobic load, introduce upper Z2 stimulus

steps.description: Build cadence to 88-92 rpm, ease into Z2
Pyramid step 1 — low Z2, HR 148-154 bpm
Pyramid step 2 — mid Z2, HR 152-158 bpm
Pyramid step 3 — upper Z2, HR 155-162 bpm — back off if HR exceeds 163
Pyramid step 4 — step back, still Z2, not recovery — HR settling 152-158 bpm
Easy spin down

sessions.name: First Z2 Run
sessions.focus: Introduce running stimulus, aerobic Z2 effort

steps.description: Z1 easy walk/jog, HR under 145 bpm — let legs find rhythm
Z2 aerobic running, HR 146-162 bpm — pace is a guide, HR is the ceiling; slow down if HR exceeds 162
Z1 easy walk/jog, HR returning below 140

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Shoulder Free
sessions.focus: Lower body strength and core stability, zero shoulder load
sessions.notes: 3 rounds: 12x Goblet Squat 22kg (3sec descent, pause at bottom), 10x Romanian Deadlift 22kg (hip hinge, soft knees), 10x TRX Split Squat per leg (rear foot in TRX, front knee tracks toe), 15x Banded Glute Bridge (band above knees, 2sec hold at top), 8x Dead Bug per side (lower back pressed to floor throughout). 45-60sec rest between exercises, 90sec between rounds. Shoulder completely unloaded throughout.

steps.description: Leg swings front/back and lateral (10 each leg), hip circles (10 each direction), 10 bodyweight squats with pause, 10 glute bridges
3 rounds of main circuit: Goblet Squat, Romanian Deadlift, TRX Split Squat, Banded Glute Bridge, Dead Bug — see notes for full reps and cues
Hip flexor stretch 60sec each side, figure-4 glute stretch 60sec each side, hamstring stretch 30sec each side

sessions.name: First Long Aerobic Ride
sessions.focus: Sustained aerobic base — longest ride in current block

steps.description: Progressive spin from 90W to 110W, cadence 88-92 rpm, HR rising naturally to low Z2 (148-152 bpm)
Block 1 — steady Z2, HR 148-158 bpm, 90 rpm — should feel sustainable all day
Block 2 — small power step up, HR 158-163 bpm max — reduce 5-8W if HR exceeds 163
Easy spin, HR returning toward 130 bpm — follow with 5min light stretching off the bike
